podcast.body: This Top 20 hit was an example of New Wave synth pop that, by 1982-83, was "essentially disco in another guys." It contributed to dance music's resurgence on the charts after the disco backlash, demonstrating a modernized sound that drew from disco production styles. "Like for example, ABC's Top 20 hit The Look of Love."
